title: Klint Kubiak says Kirk Cousins will remain Raiders' QB1 over Fernando Mendoza

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Klint Kubiak says Kirk Cousins will remain Raiders' QB1 over Fernando Mendoza
sources.description: Klint Kubiak announced his plans to stick with Kirk Cousins as the starter for Week 8, shutting the door on any quarterback controversy.
